BD_PROJECT_ID.description: Black Duck Hub project id (UUID) whose project version BOM should be imported. Resolves to /api/projects/{id} for the host description and is paired with BD_VERSION_ID to reach /api/projects/{id}/versions/{vid}/vulnerable-bom-components.

BD_VERSION_ID.description: Black Duck Hub project version id (UUID) whose BOM should be imported. Black Duck stores findings per version (one BOM per version), so this scopes the import to a specific build / release.

BD_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Optional minimum severity floor (info | low | medium | high | critical). Filters out lower-severity vulnerable-BOM entries client-side after Faraday severity normalisation (handles Black Duck's CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW enum, UNSPECIFIED/OK/NONE/UNKNOWN buckets, and CVSS base-score fallback). Defaults to info (no filtering).

name: blackduck_sca
title: Black Duck SCA (Black Duck Hub)
description: Black Duck Hub (Synopsys / Black Duck Software Composition Analysis) REST API importer. Pulls Software Composition Analysis findings from a Black Duck Hub project version's BOM and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON to stdout. Lists every component currently in the project version's BOM via /api/projects/{id}/versions/{vid}/components (paginated via offset / limit — used to populate the host description with the component count), then lists every BOM component that carries at least one vulnerability for that project version via /api/projects/{id}/versions/{vid}/vulnerable-bom-components. Each Black Duck project version becomes one Faraday host (synthetic 0.0.0.0 ip because SCA findings live in dependency manifests, not on IPs) with hostnames = {projectName}@{versionName}; per-version vulnerable-BOM entries attached as Faraday vulnerabilities — one per vulnerabilityWithRemediation with [SCA] engine prefix, componentName@componentVersionName in the title, component origin / licenses, vulnerability source (NVD / BDSA), publishedDate / updatedDate, remediationStatus / remediationTargetAt and project / version metadata in the description; remediationComment / remediation / recommendation / solution surfaces as Faraday resolution. Refs include CWE-* (single + list + list-of-dict shapes with the CWE- prefix collapsed), relatedVulnerability hrefs, source-prefixed advisory ids (BDSA-/NVD-), plus any URLs from references / links / _meta. CVE list harvested from vulnerabilityName + cve / cveId / cves (string + list-of-string + list-of-dict shapes, deduped case-insensitively) and the trailing /CVE-* path of relatedVulnerability hrefs. Severity normalised from Black Duck's string enum (CRITICAL / HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW — also accepts UNSPECIFIED / OK / NONE / UNKNOWN / Important / Moderate / Minor / Informational / Information / Negligible) with CVSS v3 bucketing as a fallback when only a numeric overallScore / baseScore is given (≤0 info, <4 low, <7 medium, <9 high, ≥9 critical); client-side BD_MIN_SEVERITY floor enforced after normalisation. Status mapped from the vulnerabilityWithRemediation's remediationStatus enum (NEW / NEEDS_REVIEW / REMEDIATION_REQUIRED → open, PATCHED / REMEDIATION_COMPLETE / MITIGATED → closed, IGNORED / DUPLICATE → risk-accepted). Auth: Black Duck Hub API tokens are exchanged for a short-lived bearer via POST /api/tokens/authenticate (header 'Authorization: token <BD_TOKEN>' → JSON {bearerToken, expiresInMilliseconds}); subsequent calls send 'Authorization: Bearer <bearerToken>'. A pre-built 'Bearer <token>' value in BD_TOKEN is accepted and routed verbatim so OAuth tokens minted by an external identity provider can skip the exchange step. BD_HOST is the Black Duck Hub base URL (e.g. https://blackduck.corp.example.com); the hosted SaaS appliance URL is also accepted.
